claims.claim: Google launched a prototype satellite on SpaceX's Transporter-18 mission to test how its TPUs handle space conditions for potential machine learning infrastructure.
claims.source_title: Google AI tweet about Project Suncatcher
claims.supporting_quote: After years of research, we’ve just launched a prototype satellite, built in partnership with @planet, into orbit on @SpaceX's Transporter-18 rideshare mission.

claims.claim: All ten AI chatbots tested, including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok, named at least one unlicensed online casino in conversations about gambling.
claims.source_title: All 10 AI chatbots tested point consumers to unlicensed online gambling sites
claims.supporting_quote: According to the Keurmerk Verantwoorde Affiliates (KVA), which examines ten popular AI bots, such tools relatively easily expose Dutch consumers to unlicensed online gambling. In the conversations with the chatbots that were studied, all ten named at least one unlicensed online casino.
